author_posts.sql: SELECT "users"."user_id", "users"."email", "users"."balance", "users"."nickname", "users"."inviter_id", "posts"."post_id", "posts"."author_id", "posts"."title" FROM "users" INNER JOIN "posts" ON "posts"."author_id" = "users"."user_id" ORDER BY "posts"."post_id" ASC

optional_posts.sql: SELECT "users"."user_id", "users"."email", "users"."balance", "users"."nickname", "users"."inviter_id", "posts"."post_id", "posts"."author_id", "posts"."title" FROM "users" LEFT JOIN "posts" ON "posts"."author_id" = "users"."user_id" ORDER BY "users"."user_id" ASC, "posts"."post_id" ASC

referrers.sql: SELECT "invitee"."user_id", "invitee"."email", "invitee"."balance", "invitee"."nickname", "invitee"."inviter_id", "inviter"."user_id", "inviter"."email", "inviter"."balance", "inviter"."nickname", "inviter"."inviter_id" FROM "users" AS "invitee" LEFT JOIN "users" AS "inviter" ON "invitee"."inviter_id" = "inviter"."user_id" ORDER BY "invitee"."user_id" ASC

balance_groups.sql: SELECT "balance" AS "balance", COUNT(*) AS "total" FROM "users" GROUP BY "balance" HAVING (COUNT(*) > ?) ORDER BY "balance" ASC

account_page.sql: SELECT DISTINCT "email", ("balance" + ?), COALESCE("nickname", ?), CASE WHEN "balance" >= ? THEN ? ELSE ? END FROM "users" ORDER BY "email" ASC LIMIT ? OFFSET ?

active_authors.sql: SELECT "user_id", "email", "balance", "nickname", "inviter_id" FROM "users" WHERE (EXISTS (SELECT "posts"."title" FROM "posts" WHERE ("posts"."author_id" = "users"."user_id"))) ORDER BY "user_id" ASC

balance_reference.sql: SELECT "email", (SELECT "users"."balance" FROM "users" ORDER BY "users"."user_id" ASC LIMIT ?) FROM "users" ORDER BY "user_id" ASC

named_accounts.sql: WITH "accounts" AS (SELECT "email" AS "email", "balance" AS "balance", 1 AS "__snekql_present" FROM "users" WHERE ("balance" >= ?)) SELECT "accounts"."email" AS "email", "accounts"."balance" AS "balance" FROM "accounts" WHERE ("accounts"."email" = ?)

account_union.sql: WITH "accounts" AS (SELECT "__snekql_union"."balance" AS "balance", "__snekql_union"."email" AS "email", 1 AS "__snekql_present" FROM (SELECT "balance" AS "balance", "email" AS "email" FROM "users" WHERE ("balance" >= ?) UNION ALL SELECT "balance" AS "balance", "email" AS "email" FROM "users" WHERE ("balance" < ?)) AS "__snekql_union") SELECT "accounts"."balance" AS "balance", "accounts"."email" AS "email" FROM "accounts" ORDER BY "accounts"."email" ASC

referral_chain.sql: WITH RECURSIVE "referrals" AS (SELECT ? AS "depth", "inviter_id" AS "inviter_id", "user_id" AS "user_id", 1 AS "__snekql_present" FROM "users" WHERE ("user_id" = ?) UNION ALL SELECT ("referrals"."depth" + ?) AS "depth", "users"."inviter_id" AS "inviter_id", "users"."user_id" AS "user_id", 1 AS "__snekql_present" FROM "users" INNER JOIN "referrals" ON "referrals"."inviter_id" = "users"."user_id" WHERE ("referrals"."depth" < ?)) SELECT "referrals"."depth" AS "depth", "referrals"."inviter_id" AS "inviter_id", "referrals"."user_id" AS "user_id" FROM "referrals" ORDER BY "referrals"."depth" ASC

refresh_nickname.sql: INSERT INTO "users" ("email", "balance", "nickname", "inviter_id") VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT ("email") DO UPDATE SET "nickname" = excluded."nickname" RETURNING "user_id", "email", "balance", "nickname", "inviter_id"
